results.title: The checkpoint ahead of the head
results.evidence: the checkpoint was moved to seq 511, five hundred beyond a chain that ends at 11, and the cheap check answers valid over 0 node(s) checked. `repo.since(mark)` returns nothing, `_walk` over an empty list reports valid, and nothing compares the mark against the head — so a chain truncated below its own checkpoint reads healthy on every readiness probe until the scheduled full walk runs
